note: PLUGIN-003 separate plugin diagnostics: stdout is the protocol and stderr is diagnostics, and src/plugin/streams.zig keeps them apart by refusing to parse a stdout line that is not a frame - it reports contamination rather than treating log text as an event or resynchronizing on whatever looks like a frame boundary inside a log line. Diagnostics are bounded before they are stored, so a plugin cannot make the core allocate without bound by never emitting a newline: an over-long line is truncated with the truncation recorded. The test covers a kept diagnostic, a truncated one, an accepted frame, a log line on stdout, an over-long frame on stdout, and an empty stdout line. Fault proof: quietly treating the contaminating line as a diagnostic makes the contamination assertion fail (exit 1); revert byte-identical against a backup, no FAULT markers remain.
authority: self-reported local review, not independent attestation
